title: TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours Payments, Late Fees, Draw Holds and Entitlements
content:
## Payments

A payment on TimeBank Prepaid Service Hours is applied to the invoice its remittance names, otherwise to the oldest open invoice first, one entry per invoice applied. Card payments are accepted only for an invoice whose total does not exceed the size's card payment limit.

## Late fees

On the first day of each calendar month every invoice still unpaid more than the size's grace days after its due date is assessed one late fee of the size's monthly late-fee percentage of its unpaid balance, or the size's minimum late fee if greater, rounded half up to the cent.

Hypothetical cases at 1.5 percent with a 25.00 minimum: an unpaid balance of 4000.00 gives 60.00; an unpaid balance of 1000.00 gives 15.00, so the fee is 25.00.

## Draw hold

For a block activated on signature whose invoice is more than the size's draw-hold days past due, new draws are put on hold until it is paid, and the work is billed as overage in the meantime.

## Entitlements

Hours statements are emailed on the size's statement cadence. Priority scheduling and a named engineer are entitlements of the block size, not billed separately.
